EE1002.title: Physics Foundation For Electrical & Electronic Engineering
EE1002.description: Introduction of electromagnetic fields and applications, Electromagnetic in electronics, circuits and communications.  Introduction to light and principles of geometric optics.  Principles of wave optics.   Introduction to quantum physics and applications.  Applications of quantum physics in electronics and lasers.

EE2010.title: Signals & Systems
EE2010.description: Signals and Systems. Linear Time-Invariant Systems. Fourier Representation of Signals and LTI Systems. Sampling. Modulation.

EE3002.title: Microprocessors
EE3002.description: Introduction to ARM core and programmer's model. Assembler Directives. Loads, Stores and Addressing. Logic and Arithmetic. Flow control instructions. Subroutines, Stacks and Exception Handling. Thumb Instructions and C language. Peripherals Interfacing.

MH1812.title: Discrete Mathematics
MH1812.description: Elementary Number Theory; Propositional Logic; Sets; Predicate Logic; Linear Recurrence Relation; Relations and Functions; Graphs; Complex Numbers; Vectors and Matrices; Elementary Combinatorics.
